description: This file defines a class to evaluate the Bessel function of the first kind (BesselJ) in PHP. It includes methods for calculating Bessel functions of orders 0, 1, and higher, with special cases and optimizations, and handles array inputs for batch processing. It is part of a calculation library within PhpSpreadsheet, specifically under the Engineering calculations.

classes.name: BesselJ
classes.description: Provides static methods to compute the Bessel function of the first kind for various orders, with support for array inputs and handling of special cases.

methods.name: BESSELJ
methods.description: Main entry point to compute the Bessel function of the first kind for a given x and order, supports array inputs, and returns errors or numeric results.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Determines which specific Bessel function computation to perform based on the order (0, 1, or higher).

methods.name: besselJ0
methods.description: Computes Bessel function of order 0 for a float x, using approximation formulas for different ranges of |x|.

methods.name: besselJ1
methods.description: Computes Bessel function of order 1 for a float x, using approximation formulas for different ranges of |x|.

methods.name: besselJ2
methods.description: Computes Bessel functions of order n > 1, selecting between two methods depending on the magnitude of x relative to order.

methods.name: besselj2a
methods.description: Iteratively computes Bessel function for large x relative to order using upward recurrence relations.

methods.name: besselj2b
methods.description: Computes Bessel function for small x relative to order using descending continued fraction or backward recurrence.
